info.name: E-Commerce & Order Management API
info.description: Run the whole collection in order with the Collection Runner. Set base_url, admin_email and admin_password in the Variables tab first. For the two receipt upload requests, select receipt.png in the file field once.

item.name: Create category as customer (should be forbidden)
Create product with duplicate SKU (should fail)
Create product with negative price (should fail)
Create product as customer (should be forbidden)
Add more than available stock (should fail)
Add item with quantity 0 (should fail validation)
Create coupon as customer (should be forbidden)
Checkout again with SAME key (idempotent, returns 200)
Add item to cart for 2nd order
Upload receipt for another customer's order (should fail)
Customer views admin receipt (should be forbidden)
Admin: approve same payment again (should fail)
Admin: reject payment with too-short reason (should fail)

exec: pm.test('Status is REJECTED with reason', function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.status).to.eql('REJECTED'); pm.expect(j.rejection_reason).to.be.a('string'); });

item.name: Admin check as customer (should be forbidden)

exec: pm.test('Order 1 is CONFIRMED after payment approval', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().status).to.eql('CONFIRMED'); });

item.name: Order 2 to CONFIRMED without approved payment (should fail)
Order 1 skip to DELIVERED (invalid, should fail)
List all orders as customer (should be forbidden)
